capabilities: search arXiv by URL or title with fuzzy matching
import paper PDFs into the vault
create notes with paper metadata (title, authors, year, URL)
insert citation wikilinks to imported paper notes
extras: The README only covers arXiv; papers from other sources are not mentioned, so coverage may be limited to that API.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull research paper metadata and PDFs from arXiv into notes or cite them as wikilinks.
summary: arXiv importer that searches papers, downloads their PDFs into the vault, and creates notes with metadata and citation wikilinks.
